extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to Emergent Ventures (entrepreneurs, researchers, thinkers, and project leaders seeking small fellowships/grants)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and eligibility/selection guidance for applying to Emergent Ventures, a low-overhead fellowship and grant program that funds highly scalable 'zero to one' ideas aimed at meaningful social improvement. Includes notes on geographic-focus support and a brief mention of the Fast Grants spin-off.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target project profile — highly scalable, 'zero to one' ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports entrepreneurs and brilliant minds with highly scalable, "zero to one" ideas for meaningfully improving society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framing language used by the program: "Bold Ideas. Transformative Social Change." The program seeks projects that create new, scalable solutions (zero to one) rather than incremental improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended impact — meaningful improvement to society
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should be aimed at "meaningfully improving society."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The emphasis is on social impact; proposals should articulate how the idea produces meaningful societal benefit rather than only private or marginal gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic focus & regional support
rubrics_metrics.description: "Grants are awarded to thinkers and doers around the world, with dedicated support available for projects with a focus on India, Africa and the Caribbean, or Ukraine."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants with a specific geographic focus should select the appropriate region from a drop-down menu on the application form; the program offers targeted/dedicated support for those named regions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant eligibility — age requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: "To be eligible for an EV grant, all applicants must be 13 years of age or older."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit, non-waivable eligibility criterion stated on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global applicant acceptance / award scope
rubrics_metrics.description: "Grants are awarded to thinkers and doers around the world."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program accepts and funds applicants internationally; applicants should be aware that funding and support are provided globally rather than restricted to a single country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program model — low-overhead fellowship/grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Emergent Ventures is described as a "low-overhead fellowship and grant program."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This suggests streamlined application/administration and relatively light bureaucracy; applicants can expect a lean program structure though specific process details are not provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fast Grants (related program) — rapid funding for COVID-19 science
rubrics_metrics.description: "Fast Grants launched in April 2020 as a spin-off of Emergent Ventures to swiftly support scientists working on COVID-19 vaccines and treatments."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual/history note: Fast Grants provided rapid funding (raised >$50M and awarded 260 grants). For COVID-19 science-specific rapid funding, refer to fastgrants.org as noted on the page.
